requiredConfiguration: Explicit Pi MCP adapter plus a named Linear server, or a dedicated helper.
Read-only credentials supplied through the configured transport, never embedded in prompts or command arguments.
A static allowlist and bounded request timeout.
A response schema that validates issue id, identifier, title, labels, status, and repository metadata before dispatch.
safeInvocation: Use Pi JSON mode only when the configured capability is the selected adapter. Disable sessions, project resources, unneeded extensions, and write-capable tools.

failureRules.notConfigured: unsupported capability; surface actionable configuration error
failureRules.toolNotRegistered: unsupported capability; do not return an empty result
failureRules.authentication: surface auth failure; retry only when transport marks it transient
failureRules.timeoutOrServerUnavailable: transient query failure after bounded retry policy
failureRules.malformedResponse: permanent adapter-contract failure with sanitized diagnostic
failureRules.otherRuntime: never fall back to Claude or Codex

outOfScope: Live Linear credentials and production helper implementation are not part of this spike.
